name: fastapi_undocumented
description: Negative control. Five endpoints, zero API documentation — the README covers installation, running, contributing and license, and never names an endpoint or describes a resource. DocZot must report these as gaps. Crediting any of them as documented means the gap detector is inventing coverage.
notes: No operation is documented, so operation coverage is exactly 0%. Any non-zero value means credit was invented — either by harvesting markdown from outside the analyzed tree, or by treating a heading that resembles a noun as documentation of the operations on it. That is the failure mode this case exists to catch.
